title: WEEKNUM of Sunday January 2, 2005: 2 by default, 1 with Monday weeks, 53 in the ISO system
query: EVALUATE VAR s = DATE ( 2005, 1, 2 ) RETURN ROW ( "default", WEEKNUM ( s ), "t2", WEEKNUM ( s, 2 ), "iso", WEEKNUM ( s, 21 ) )

source.quote: WEEKNUM returns the week number following different standards
source.supports: the example table lists 2005-01-02, Sunday, with WEEKNUM 2, WEEKNUM 2 = 1, WEEKNUM 21 = 53

source.quote: The week containing January 1 is the first week of the year and is numbered week 1.
source.supports: system 1; with Sunday weeks January 2, 2005 starts week 2
